scope: Actual numerical solver, matched flat-world initial conditions; original 3.9/3.12 physics source frozen, current scene reduced to common ground before integration. No WebGL or human flight acceptance, no OEM calibration.
heightScope: heightM is CG world height above the common y=0 floor. rigidEnvelopeClearanceM is the lowest transformed rigid collision AABB point, including wheel bump stops; it excludes suspension ray/visual-tire extension. Contact gates independently check both rigid and ray contacts.
metricsScope: Automatic: all 120 Hz steps through final telemetry at completion + 119/120 s (0.991667 s) of ordinary control settling; completion gas/impulse separated from the approximately one-second post-completion totals. The last stored 20 Hz row can precede final telemetry; rejected rows are not executed. Manual: real input sequence through a continuous 0.5 s recovery window; 20 Hz curves plus the terminal recovery sample. G preserves the existing flight-height reference rather than automatically returning to the origin.

checks.name: Frozen baseline sources retain their original bytes except relocated imports, with unchanged shared physical dependencies
Matched complete 3.9 / 3.12 / current X runs retain actual force, trajectory, gas and contact outcomes
Fast reference is independent of comfort sliders; nozzle torque and short-takeoff authority remain physical
Quick-roll practice uses E, then Z, then G through real input APIs, with a sustained recovery window and complete curves
Low pressure, torque loss, ceiling, descent and unstable initial conditions reject without physical mutation
Repeated X cannot restart a running roll; G cancels to a level heading reference without changing body state
A real main-nozzle fault during rotation is a failed program and retains its physical recovery controller
Current fast-roll snapshots continue exactly and legacy 3.12 profile is preserved during explicit current-model mapping
